merge_policy.hosting: The versioned domain bases and this hotfix overlay are delivered as static JSON over GitHub Pages; a client fetches both from that origin, so a hotfix ships as a data update and no released base file is edited.
merge_policy.order: Clients fetch the versioned domain base first and this hotfix file second, then apply the hotfixes array in listed order over the base entries matched by id.
merge_policy.precedence: Last write wins: a hotfix entry with the same id replaces the base entry text for serving; a hotfix with a new id adds a served entry without editing the base file.
merge_policy.provenance: Every hotfix carries a reason naming the evidence (commit, probe output, or doc section) that forced it; a hotfix without a reason is rejected.
merge_policy.base_immutable: You never edit a released versioned base to fix a fact; you append a hotfix here and the next release folds it into the base with a version bump.
merge_policy.applicability: A hotfix carries version_range like any entry; a client whose kit version falls outside the range ignores that hotfix and serves the base text.
